stem: The Pattiseema Project is associated with the integration of which of the following rivers?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above | More than one of the above

expl: The Pattiseema Lift Irrigation Project is related to the interlinking of the Krishna and Godavari rivers. This project is implemented by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

stem: The maximum irrigation potential of India is created through:
expl: The largest share of India’s irrigation potential is fulfilled by minor and major irrigation projects. Under minor irrigation projects, irrigation is provided to areas of 2,000 hectares or less, which include wells, tube-wells, pump sets, ponds, drip irrigation, sprinklers, and anicuts.

stem: The origin of the Indira Gandhi Canal, which irrigates the Thar desert, is -

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The Indira Gandhi Canal originates from the Harike Barrage in Punjab and extends into the Thar Desert of Rajasthan. The canal flows through the districts of Hanumangarh, Phalodi, Bikaner, Jaisalmer, and Sri Ganganagar.

stem: Which of the following is called the longest canal in India?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: India’s longest canal is the Indira Gandhi Canal. It enters Rajasthan near Hanumangarh and originates from the Harike Barrage in Punjab, located beyond the confluence of the Sutlej and Beas rivers. The canal was constructed to irrigate the arid regions of western Rajasthan and to provide drinking water to the local population.

stem: For what purpose is water used the most in India?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: In India, the maximum amount of water is used for irrigation purposes.

stem: Bhakra nangal is a joint project of –
expl: The Bhakra Nangal multi-purpose project is a joint undertaking of the states of Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan. Under this project, two dams have been constructed on the Sutlej River at Bhakra and near Nangal.

expl: The Bhakra Nangal multi-purpose project is a joint undertaking of the states of Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan. Under this project, two dams have been constructed on the Sutlej River at Bhakra and near Nangal.

stem: Which of the following is the oldest hydropower station in India?
expl: Hydropower development began in the last decade of the nineteenth century. In 1897, the country’s first hydropower plant was established at Sidrapong in Darjeeling. At Shivsamudram, located on the Kaveri River in Karnataka, a hydropower generation plant was established in 1902. Therefore, among the given options, (d) is the intended answer.

stem: ‘nagarjuna Sagar Multipurpose Project’ is on which river?
expl: The Nagarjuna Sagar multi-purpose project is a major project. It has been constructed on the Krishna River. At present, this project is spread across the states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

stem: On which river is the Hirakud dam constructed?
expl: Hirakud Dam is a multi-purpose project built on the Mahanadi River in the state of Odisha. It is about 60.96 metres (maximum) high and 4.8 km in length (length of the main dam). The total length of the dam is 25.8 km. Through this project, irrigation is provided to about 155635/159106 hectares of Kharif crops and 108385 hectares of Rabi crops.

stem: Maithon, Belpahari and Tilaya dams are constructed on the river-
expl: The Maithon and Tilaiya dams were constructed on the Barakar River, a tributary of the Damodar, in the first phase of the Damodar Valley Project, whereas the Belpahari dam is proposed on the Damodar River.

stem: When was the damodar valley Corporation established?
expl: After the consent of Bihar and West Bengal, the Central Government passed the Damodar Valley Corporation Act (Act No. XIV) in March 1948. Under this Act, on 7 July 1948, the Damodar Valley Corporation, the first multi-purpose river valley project of independent India, came into existence.

stem: On which river did Prime Minister narendra Modi recently lay the foundation stone for the Mandal dam project?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: On 5 January 2019, Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone of the irrigation and drinking water schemes of the North Koel (Mandal Dam) Project at Medininagar in Palamu district of Jharkhand. This project is being constructed on the North Koel River, a tributary of the Son River.

stem: Rana Pratap Sagar Hydroelectric Project on Chambal River is located in the State of :

expl: The Rana Pratap Sagar Hydroelectric Project is located on the Chambal River. It is related to the Chambal Valley Development Programme. This project is situated in Rajasthan.

stem: Which two countries signed the Kosi Irrigation and Hydroelectric Project Agreement in 1954?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: In 1954, the agreement for the Kosi Irrigation and Hydroelectric Project was signed between the Republic of India and Nepal. The agreement on the Gandak Project between India and Nepal was signed in 1959.
